 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League C - Game Week 6 Nov 15, 2026 - 09:00 Skonto Stadium Latvia host Armenia at Skonto Stadium in Riga in a UEFA Nations League C Group 2 fixture, with both sides looking to close out their campaign on a positive note.
 Paolo Nicolato's Latvia arrive in poor form and have struggled throughout this Nations League cycle. They have lost four of their last five matches and were beaten 2-1 by Montenegro in their most recent outing on November 12.
 Armenia head into this match having drawn 1-1 with Cyprus on November 12, a result that continues a mixed run for Yegishe Melikyan's side. They have won just once in their last five games, though that victory — a 2-0 win over Latvia earlier in the campaign — will give them confidence ahead of this return fixture.
 Latvia sit fourth in Group 2, with Armenia one place above them in third. Neither side can challenge for promotion, but both will want to finish the group stage with something to show.
